newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in thin trade on Monday afternoon with most traders sidelined ahead of the Christmas holidays, dealers said.
"The market was really quiet this afternnon. A lot of the traders are already on leave and most people are just getting ready for the coming Christmas holidays," a local dealer said.

He said the release of the U.S. Gross Domestic Product 1996 data on Friday had no impact and that he did not expect the release of the U.S. November personal income data later on Monday to have an impact on the market either.
"Some are squaring off their positions in the short term and no one is interested to open new positions because of the coming holidays" he added.

In short dates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-1/4 5-1/8 percent from last Friday's 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent and week-fixed rose 1-3/16 percentage point from Friiday's 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent.

Among term rates, one-month was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, three-months, five-months rose 1/16 percentage point toto a common 5-5/8 5-1/2 from Friday's common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, and twelve-months also unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent.
